notes.content:
“Welcome to Jurassic Park.”

We are happy to announce that the Jurassic Park Pinball and Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem tables have been updated with music from the original film.

[previewyoutube=5aMdWO0bP8U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Star Wars™ Pinball tables joined the Steam library!
notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans!

With the arrival of Pinball FX to Steam, we have many new tables to show you on the platform! Let us guide you to a galaxy far far away, on two brand new additions to the Star Wars Pinball library, which will be available in the[b] Star Wars™ Pinball: Thrill of the Hunt[/b] pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/38fba9a981a012a3f0f9d7ed3e077f38159a36fa.jpg[/img]

The first one is [b]Star Wars Pinball: The Mandalorian™[/b]! Based on the first season of the Disney+ show, The Mandalorian-inspired pinball table features 3D characters like Mando, the Child, and IG-11 and famous locations like Arvala-7, Sorgan, or Nevarro. On the table, you can accept bounties, pursue targets, find the Child, and fight Imperial remnant stormtroopers and other bounty hunters. notes.title: Pinball FX3 - The Big Fix
notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans! 

We are happy to announce that we fixed bugs in Pinball FX3 many of you have reported since the game has been released. Take a deep breath, and try to read out loud all the fixes we made! If you can ;)

[h2]Zen Originals:[/h2]

[b]Sorcerers Lair:[/b]

- Fixed a camera issue in the Behind The Walls mission while playing in Portrait Mode
- Fixed a Z-fighting on the overlap with the blue stones
- Fixed an issue where nudging the table during skillshot could break the table
- Fixed an issue where the end of the Forest Loop mode can break the table if you hit the Citadel ramp within a short time period

[b]Additional tables:[/b]

- On Epic Quest, we fixed an issue where Game Over was triggered during multiball along with minor localization corrections
- Fixed the bonus multiplier on Adventure Land
- Fixed an issue in the Doppelganger mission where players could get stuck after nudging the table on Paranormal
- Fixed an issue where the ball could be launched to the drain from the Romulus hole

[h2]Williams Pinball tables:[/h2]

Please note that due to the nature of some updates your saved game states will be no longer available on the following tables:
- Theatre of Magic™
- Road Show™
- Dr. Dude and his Excellent Ray™
- No Good Gofers™

- Corrected the spin disc behavior on Safe Cracker™
- Fixed an issue where the ball can get stuck at the entrance to the dual Ferris Wheels on Hurricane™
- Fixed entry gate issue along with some typos on Road Show™
- On White Water™, we fixed the camera zoom issue during multiball and made adjustments to the Insanity Ramp
- Fixed an issue where the balls get stuck in the kickers on Party Zone™
- Corrected typo issues on No Good Gofers™

[h2]Star Wars Pinball tables:[/h2]

-  On Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope, we fixed a bug in Scene 3 where the game could stuck, breaking the playthrough along with other gfx issue fixes
- Fixed an issue with Smuggler Multiball to prevent unfair ball loss on Calrissian Chronicles
- On the Darth Vader table, the maxed-out multiplier gives a score reward in one ball challenge

[h2]Marvel Pinball tables:[/h2]

- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck during the Wizard mode with no balls on the playfield on Marvel’s The Avengers table
- The Doctor Strange table was tweaked so the ball is less likely to drain so many times on the outlanes
- Fixed a TILT issue with Mandarin Flame Blast during challenge modes on the Iron Man table
- On the Wolverine table, we made adjustments where ramp shots didn’t not progress Combo perk

[h2]Others:[/h2]

- Fixed an issue where the ball could get stuck in the bumpers on Alien vs. Predator Pinball
- On the Doom table, we fixed an issue where the music doesn't change during Hotseat mode, We also improved the flasher clips and fixed a nudge issue with the weapon selector
- Fixed camera view orders on Jaws to match the other tables on Steam


Thank you very much to all for your patience especially to those who contributed to this patch by reporting these bugs. notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR arrives on April 29!
notes.content:
Get those VR headsets ready and immerse yourself into [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball like never before! [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR will arrive on Steam VR, Oculus Quest 1 & 2, and PlayStation VR on April 29, 2021! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530770/Star_Wars_Pinball_VR/]Add the game to your wishlist now and be the first to be notified upon release![/url]

[previewyoutube=3TLPOCR_48s;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are three points why your inner [i]Star Wars[/i] fan can high five your mental pinball enthusiast when jumping into the galaxy of [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR ([i]they can high five now if you can’t wait *slap*![/i]):


[b]1. Eight amazing tables in VR:[/b]

The game arrives with beloved classics and introduces two brand new tables never before released. A table based on the hit Lucasfilm series, [i]The Mandalorian[/i] will take you through the first season of the show as you pick up bounties, rescue The Child and meet characters like IG-11. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/8c9f07cd76a8619324af6793d22e2c72c8d239f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/ec65a365623c61d4342d51bce7f4258f284cfa1d.png[/img]

Classic Collectibles lets you collect classic [i]Star Wars[/i] action figures as you complete missions. Feel like a kid again as the figures come alive and you unlock more and more precious items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/d492fd9882b39482bef998877db9bcae6d77fe72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/304e9201517372144c41b0b56ee6fe2c86f691cc.png[/img]

Joining the new tables will be fan-favorites like [i]Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope, Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back, Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi, Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, Star Wars Rebels,[/i] and [i]Star Wars: Masters of the Force.[/i]


[b]2. A customizable Fan Cave serves as the main game hub[/b]

Who doesn’t want to build their very own nook filled with[i] Star Wars[/i] memorabilia, collectibles, and art? In [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR you can do just that as all of the action occurs in a fully customizable “fan cave,” which houses your “virtual” pinball table as well as many [i]Star Wars[/i] helmets, blasters, lightsabers, and other items earned through successful play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/49d53b3f8d23661d1bce9d2383cac610954acc21.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/7c22b3aa21f74dd4c43d14c6db40333bab8d2117.png[/img]

Start up a new table to play and life-sized characters and vehicles will be joining you on either side.


[b]3.	New features and room for more[/b]

We are bringing table minigames to the next level. Never before has a speeder bike chase or the duel with Darth Vader™ felt so intense in [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball as when the action surrounds you fully 360 degrees as you start the appropriate mode in the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/a9f3ba76b5225217a77a01eeaa76cb19bb7b221b.png[/img]

There is room for more in [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR as the game is built to be expanded upon so the blast doors are certainly open for more content! 

Check back regularly for more details on the tables & features as we go forward and please feel free to discuss and reach out to us in the community.

Watch our reveal and an interview with game Producer Akos Szabo on the Pinball Show for even more on the game: 

[previewyoutube=9RGMxClOKOA;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, please take a moment to consider wishlisting the game, it helps us spread the love of pinball and [i]Star Wars[/i] to more people and you will also get the happy news of our release straight into your inbox. 

The Zen Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/6b3833740e096b4491c5b5fa6899386dc625830e.png[/img]

Especially in this environment, where not everyone can go to arcades let us try to bond over hobby any way we can. [b]Join the tremendous community leagues and tournaments here:[/b]

[url=http://www.lupsclub.com/]Lup’s Club - French-speaking pros: [/url]

[url=https://hynagang.wixsite.com/hynagang]Hyna Gang - Challenges, tournaments, and fun all around[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/PinballFamily]Pinball Family - Old as Pinball FX on Steam and very active[/url]

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PinballFX3/]Reddit Williams Classic League - Sprouted up from the Pinball FX subreddit[/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/216402738537815/]Original PlayStation Pinball League - A tightly knit group holding high score filled tourneys on PlayStation[/url]

We wish you a nice time playing on these amazing tables!

notes.title: Come one, come all! Williams™ Pinball: Volume 5 now available in Pinball FX3!
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, Zen Studios welcomes you to this year’s closing Williams Show! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203510/Pinball_FX3__Williams_Pinball_Volume_5/

Our available seats are at the PlayStation 4, Steam, Nintendo Switch, Mac, Xbox One & Windows 10 parlors! We also have places in the Williams Pinball Application booth, for Android and iOS visitors. Grab your hot pretzels! Hold on to that popcorn tightly! Because tonight, we have a marvel to behold!

And now… on with the show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/0471bedd5f05f7f38812b17cb846245fbb86ea8d.png[/img]

First, coming deep from the bazaars of middle-east, I present to you: the Tales of the Arabian Nights! A thrilling story of magic, wonders, and tales of the old, with one key piece missing: you! A brave hero, collecting the mysterious jewels with the help of their faithful companion, Dimira, to empower your scimitar for the upcoming battle against the Evil Genie, who’s holding our beloved princess captive. Help her, and your efforts shall be rewarded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/6b06b9a0a3e8603e02c882a1c942e3ae0e32a8f5.png[/img]

And the show goes on! Now, on to our second performance: the marvels of Cirqus Voltaire!

“No no, my dear, don’t let the ringmaster taunt you -- he does this all the time.” Pay attention, my guests, as the balls are locking in, the rope-dancers start to ascend their poles, getting ready to position. Watch as they confidently walk on their ropes, despite the fact that each conducts electricity! Watch the Boom balloon popping, the cannon blowing, the acrobats flying. And watch this! Should you feel worthy of our ranks, we dare you to challenge us, and should you topple our obstacles, the Cirqus Voltaire welcomes you as its artist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/787cbaa5c056717301885bb33177d5d7cf12cbc4.png[/img]

And last, but not least, the final act of tonight: 

Two little gophers set their eyes onto something much bigger than themselves in No Good Gofers… an entire golf course! You, my dear spectator, should bring your best golf skills here, as these little ones are relentless. They will do everything to wreck your scores, and make you suffer from bogey fives! Go for those Hole-in-Ones, try to not hit the ball out of bounds, and most importantly: watch out for those little gophers, because I can assure you: they have no good intentions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203510/Pinball_FX3__Williams_Pinball_Volume_5/

That’s it for tonight, ladies and gentlemen. The show is over, but fear not!

The wonders of Volume 5 are available now!

See you next time!

-    [url=http://bit.ly/MonstersSwitch]Nintendo Switch[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167870/Pinball_FX3__Williams_Pinball_Universal_Monsters_Pack/

Join the party with Dracula and his friends in the spookiest gig of the Fall, or take the Halloween feeling to a drive-in movie date! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/ec2967d0015ca72ddd2ad35cd32c7ca864b96eaf.png[/img]

The Monster Bash pinball table was released in July 1998, featuring several classic Universal Monsters forming a rock band. It became one of the highest-rated machines of all time, not surprisingly, as it has a superb layout, mad rules and insanely stackable modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29366727/b13c01723946374d32cdfd3e9f73d2ca6256c567.png[/img]

Released in 1992, the Creature from the Black Lagoon pinball table got its theme from the classic movie of the same title, a film shot in 3D in the early 1950s. The table is set up as a drive-in cinema typical of the era, with features like a snack bar, a rude driver whose van blocks the screen, and of course the Creature, lurking in his lagoon.

Take on the beautiful mix of pinball wizardry and nostalgia in these classic tables, now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-hu/product/EP4042-CUSA04907_00-PINBALLFX3WMSMOK]PlayStation 4[/url], [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/pinball-fx3-williams-pinball-universal-monsters-pack/9nk0bsstpczv?rtc=3&activetab=pivot:overviewtab]Xbox One & Windows 10[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167870/Pinball_FX3__Williams_Pinball_Universal_Monsters_Pack/]Steam[/url], [url=http://bit.ly/MonstersSwitch]Nintendo Switch[/url], and Mac.

notes.title: Pinball FX3 is one of the first games supported by Remote Play!
notes.content:
We've noticed some of you talking about it in the forums, but for you who might be hearing of this for the first time:

Great news everyone!

Pinball FX3 is joining the roster as one of the first games supported by Remote Play. That means that from now on, you can play Pinball FX3 from your Phone, Tablet, or even TV.

Don't have the right rig to access your game, want to lay back on your couch, or you just simply want to play anytime, anywhere? Just start streaming the game between your devices, and it's all set!

Ok, but how can you do that?

1. Log into Steam on your computer.
2. Download Steam Link, and enter the PIN you receive in Steam>Settings>Remote Play on your PC.
3. Visit your library and pick Pinball FX3!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H3eRINW.gif[/img]

That's it you're ready to roll, and climb the leaderboards: now from wherever you'd like.

Thanks,
Jeno

notes.title: Williams Pinball Volume 4 sweeps into Pinball FX3 today!
notes.content:
[b]...and a few tips your kid-self would have loved to know when you were sinking quarters into these games. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1086760/Pinball_FX3__Williams_Pinball_Volume_4/
It’s the early ‘90s. Life is good -- you’ve just beaten Super Metroid.
You go down to the local arcade to play some pinball. You finally managed to start multiball on Road Show, hit the skillshot on Hurricane, and nailed that shot into Insanity Falls on White Water on White Water. As these tables arrive to Pinball FX3 here are a few tips you wish you knew back then: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/0401e2b4da646a2a7b5c0fae35765759451ba0ed.jpg[/img]

[b]White Water[/b] has a tricky sinkhole return, just left above the flippers. If you don’t want to lose your ball right when you would get it back, keep the right flipper upright to catch it safely. Another advanced trick to be aware of is that if you miss your first shot on the upper playfield - no problem! You can just nudge the ball back to the flipper and try again. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/1eb5e9adf41c9f0aea072be7d3cc0c1bc3167090.jpg[/img]

Souvenirs might be worth your while on [b]Road Show[/b], as they give bonuses to the main modes. Try for the skillshot -- which gives you one for free -- or trade in some of your points in Bob’s Souvenir Bunker. If you’re having trouble landing that shot on the Blast Targets, you can trap the ball on the flipper adjacent to them for a short time to aim your shot better. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/7b50d52e07461fea74ac21b7648f6ae9a23c3f84.jpg[/img]

[b]Hurricane[/b] rewards consistent ramp shots, so if you get into the rhythm of shooting the middle ramp, you will shoot to the top of the leaderboards. Same goes for the Hurricane ramp on the right, you can rake in big millions as the game gives you back the ball to make the next shot instantly.

notes.title: Buckle up! Williams Pinball Volume 4 is a wild ride with 3 new tables and revamped flipper physics.
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/kxffqId09Kk

White Water, Red & Ted’s Road Show and Hurricane will be released on May 28 to Steam. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/0401e2b4da646a2a7b5c0fae35765759451ba0ed.jpg[/img]

Volume 4 brings you a wild set of tables. We know a lot of you are especially looking forward to White Water, a unique fan-favorite machine. With one of the most satisfying ramps in pinball -- at least in my opinion --  a prominent, furry Bigfoot toy, and an innovative multilayered playfield, this pin will fit quite nicely into your collection. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/1eb5e9adf41c9f0aea072be7d3cc0c1bc3167090.jpg[/img]

Red & Ted’s Road Show offers a wide body and takes you from coast to coast of the United States, as you look for fun and travel to 18 different cities! Smash cabs in New York, party at Mardi Gras in New Orleans, and meet monsters in San Francisco, to name a few. With a built-in shaker motor and the evolution of Williams’ PinMation™ concept, this table is packed with features. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/7b50d52e07461fea74ac21b7648f6ae9a23c3f84.jpg[/img]

Hurricane, a 1991 classic, is the last table in Barry Oursler’s amusement park trilogy and the finishing piece of Williams Pinball Volume 4. A quirky atmosphere, long, flowing ramps, and a 3D-animated clown that we’ve added to Remastered mode guarantee the carnival feeling as you ride the Ferris wheels and the titular ride itself -- the Hurricane! 

This release brings a brand new feature too! Our pinball team here at Zen Studios is on a mission to elevate our pinball simulation to higher and higher levels. This newest improvement to Pinball FX3 is a redesigned flipper physics system for the Williams Pinball Volume 4 tables. The flippers now behave more like their real-life counterparts, meaning they react to the weight of the ball, and they wobble when snapping to upright position and when going back down. 

We’d like to thank the mods and operators of digitalpinballfans.com for helping us test out this new feature, and we’d like to ask for the feedback of you in the broader community as well. 

The Pro Physics introduced with Williams Pinball last fall achieved its current form with your help in the Steam community Open Beta -- a practice we’d like to continue into the future!

notes.title: Weekly Sale - Bethesda Pinball - 50% off
notes.content:
Good day all! 

I hope I don't anger the pinball gods if I say this Bethesda Pinball is probably my favorite Pinball FX3 pack - and now it's 50% off! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/82ca4a4025af9859d66242b0786fe590dd14810f.jpg[/img]


[b]DOOM [/b]is the magnum opus of David 'ndever' Szucs - as said so by himself. It captures the relentless, gory and metal vibe of the 2016 shooter in a way that makes your heart pump. Equip the Big Fu...Flipping Gun and shoot the Cyberdemon in the face on this epic table. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/fd1daacc2be611d9f3caab2ebf26302d65346a8b.jpg[/img]

The development of [b]Skyrim [/b]took a lot of sleepless nights for both Peter 'Deep' Grafl and his QA partner Peter 'Pewet' Horvath. Putting an inventory system, a leveling system, a fight mechanic, dragon shouts, faction modifiers, quests, skill levels, different weapons with damage stats, lockpicking and a dungeon minigame into a pinball table seemed impossible at times. The result is a very unique table that has a deep metagame all the while remaining a fun pinball experience. Also, you get to whack dragons in the snout. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/4c2e35ccd0d2e3453805608943871fdf41b7c060.jpg[/img]

[b]Fallout [/b]pinball takes everything you liked about Fallout 4 and puts it into a fun and rewarding pinball table. From putting points into your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. and creating your character, through exploring a large number of vaults (oh those cute bobblehead rewards...) right up to a Super mutant pestering you constantly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/9bf0b2a9e896abb77c55f7265c7779857c594371.jpg[/img]

Pick it up now 50% off until March 18.

notes.title: Abrakadabra! Williams Pinball Volume 3 arrives March 19
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/us-rF2iOQvg

It’s no illusion - Williams Pinball Volume 3 arrives with [b]Theatre of Magic, The Champion Pub and Safe Cracker[/b]!

We’ve been seeing the energy of the community ramping up as we started the year. We read every new tweet, comment or email that said [i]‘Just give at least a hint of Volume 3!’ [/i]with a proud smile. Now the time is here to tell you about the newest additions to the Pinball FX3 library. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/6a263319cf5fac7c2e18c1594f3a94b3e370dd2a.jpg[/img]

[b]Theatre of Magic[/b] has been one of the most requested tables since we announced our Williams partnership last year - well deserved for a table that’s Top 20 on Pinside and the #3 table in the International Pinball Database! This Bally classic presents a shadowy old theatre where wondrous powers have lain dormant for years. Meet the ravishing young magician who vanishes into her magician’s hat, and floats in mid-air, or levitate balls in the Spirit Ring - you’ll see this old venue holds many secrets…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/a3064fb34bf5dc1ab3962d75679c015b70a8fd3a.jpg[/img]

A [b]The Champion Pub[/b] machine has been the jewel of the Zen Studios office for years. With only 1369 units produced, this rare game is a pleasure to walk by every day. Come on in and pound a few in this Bally pinball classic and become The Pub Champion! You’ll have all the equipment you need to train for this prestigious title, including a heavy bag, a speed bag and the part Tom mentions in the video - the jump rope! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/b7c202a3007cbc54f0aba2a342bbafe058ce60e4.jpg[/img]

On [b]Safe Cracker[/b], you work against the clock to break into the bank vault that holds magic tokens. But this won’t be an easy feat, the bank is full of guards, laser beams, alarms, exploding gifts and even cyber-dogs – yes, you heard me right, I said cyber-dogs!

So, there you go, that’s the low down on these three fantastic tables. And just like our previous Williams Pinball packs, Williams Pinball: Volume 3 is available to play both in their classic original form as well as the remastered form with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features!  

You’ll hear more about this new Volume if you check in with us on social media! Either on our Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Reddit or Discord. We'll also update you regularly here.

notes.title: Pinball FX3 is getting tables from the legendary Williams and Bally line
notes.content:
Developer Zen Studios has announced that it has secured the digital rights to Williams and Bally's full library of classic pinball tables, and that it will begin introducing them to Pinball FX3 soon.

The Williams and Bally license was previously held by developer FarSight Studios, and its popular Pinball Arcade game featured some of the manufacturer's most beloved tables, including those based on The Addams Family, Twilight Zone, and Star Trek: The Next Generation. However, in May this year, FarSight revealed that its licenses would expire at the end of June, and that all its Williams and Bally tables would be withdrawn from sale.

As for Zen Studios, the developer has already created tables based on some massive properties for its Pinball FX series - including the likes of Marvel, Star Wars, and Jurassic World - but these have all been original designs. The Williams and Bally license marks the first time that Zen has been able to recreate classic arcade tables in-game.

Read more…

notes.title: Discount coupons for single PFX2 table owners
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I am very happy to bring you good news about one of the most discussed issues since we launched Pinball FX3. You have reached out to us about something that affected a number of you guys, and we’ve come up with a solution we hope can resolve this.

The completionists among you told us that you have had some trouble filling in your Pinball FX3 library with the introduction of table packs. For example, there was no way for you to purchase Rogue One without paying for the pack that includes Rebels, which you already owned and imported from Pinball FX2.

As of now, you should start to see coupons in your Steam inventory if you have owned certain Pinball FX2 tables. 

You will receive an 80% pack discount coupon for each of the following tables:

Fantastic Four
Captain America
Doctor Strange
Civil War
Deadpool
Venom
Guardians of the Galaxy
Age of Ultron
Ant-Man
Mars
Paranormal
Earth Defense

You will receive a 75% pack discount coupon for each of the following tables:
 
Star Wars™ Pinball: Star Wars Rebels™
Star Wars™ Pinball: Rogue One™
Epic Quest
Excalibur

Let me give you an example in the use of these coupons:

You owned Fantastic Four and Captain America from the Marvel Legends pack. You will receive TWO 80% discount coupons for the Marvel Legends pack. This means, you can buy the missing Doctor Strange table for a very discounted price and still surprise a friend with some great value pinball!

These coupons will be live for only three weeks, so make sure to use them to complete your collections!

We would like to thank you for your patience and your drive to complete your Pinball FX3 collections. And we hope you’ll have fun with the tables you haven’t experienced before!

 
All the best,


Zen Team

notes.title: Beta Branch updates - 2018.01.16.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

we uploaded some new potential fixes to the Beta Branch:

- remember the 'Checking tables' bug where the game could freeze up at start at 'Checking tables'? The Beta Branch now should have a fix for that. Those of you who experienced this, please switch over and try the starting the game a few times 

- There was a demand for shorter Tournament time options, so now users are  able to create 1,2,4 and 8 hour-long tournaments. Please try out this feature before we implement it to the main game

Thanks, 

Zen Team


You can access the Beta Branch in the following way: 

1. In your Steam Library, right click on Pinball FX3 then select Properties

2. In the Properties window, select Betas tab

3. Enter the following beta access code: Pinball17CabinetBeta

4. Right above the code entry field select cabinet - Cabinet branch

5. Wait until the game updates itself then you may launch it

notes.title: Pick up our newest pack Carnivals and Legends FREE OF CHARGE from December 12-19
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29366727/30c873c6710ff8db48575ab09c834b3110a486df.jpg[/img]

We are really happy to announce that our newest Zen Original pack – Carnivals and Legends debuts today!

Punch in your ticket, grab the handles and prepare for a thrilling ride in ‘Adventure Land’, which takes you to the theme parks of old. You can enjoy the attractions the park has to offer in a table that takes inspiration from the physical pinball machines you knew and loved in the arcade. We believe ‘old-school’ pinball fans will have a lot of fun with ‘Adventure Land’, where the mix of video game effects and traditional pinball gameplay leans greatly to the latter.

The second table of the pack takes a different approach. In ‘Son of Zeus’ you will be able to brave the Labors of Hercules with lots of awesome features packed into this true hybrid of video game and pinball experience! Battle mythological creatures like Medusa, the Hydra, the three-headed dog Cerberus and the mighty Titan, Cronos. Watch out for the weather effects affecting the ball, and unlock the 8-ball multiball!

We would like to thank you for your continued support for over a decade and we hope we can share our love of pinball for many years to come!

notes.title: Steam update 11.29.
notes.content:
Hi guys & gals, 

we just put out a new update with the following features. Thank you for everyone who took the time to help us try these out in the Beta Branch! 

You can expect the following changes: 

[b] Fix for the tables disappearing on first launch [/b]

Multiple times the charm? Our Beta Branch users gave us positive feedback about this fix. You should see all your owned tables properly from now on with every launch of the game. 

[b] Dotmatrix enter initials screen is back! [/b]

- Lot of you asked for it, and cabinet players absolutely needed it, so the old-school mode of putting your initials into the Local Highscores is now back. 
You can activate it if you go to Options -> UI/Streaming -> Enter Initials: Classic

If you have this option in place, you may have to wait a few seconds before the table results come in. 

[b] The game now has a taskbar icon [/b]

Um, yeah it looks much neater this way. 

[b] News feed order fix [/b]

Tweaked the News feed a little so it'll better display relevant information, and support the Official Tournaments more effectively. 

[b] Sorcerer's Lair vertical fix [/b]

There was a bug where the 'Behind the Walls' mission in vertical mode got a stuck camera when played the second time. 

Thank you

notes.content:

- You should not lose a game when you got more points than your opponent anymore
